issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: MiniMax H3
products.tagline: Unified video generation for motion design and branding
products.summaryZh: 面向动态设计与品牌塑造的统一视频生成
products.descriptionZh: MiniMax H3是一款开放多模态模型，可生成带原生立体声的2K视频。它统一了文本、图像和音频输入，擅长精准文本渲染、视觉包装及复杂指令遵循，适用于商业内容创作。
products.description: MiniMax H3 is an open multimodal model that generates 2K video with native stereo sound. It unifies text, image, and audio inputs, excelling at accurate text rendering, visual packaging, and complex instruction following for commercial content creation.

products.name: Cleanlist AI
products.tagline: Natural-language prospecting: find, enrich and sync leads.
products.summaryZh: 自然语言线索挖掘：发现、丰富并同步潜在客户。
products.descriptionZh: Cleanlist AI将任何潜在客户输入转化为经过验证、丰富且可直接用于CRM的线索列表。上传CSV、粘贴LinkedIn或Sales Navigator链接、添加域名或使用搜索筛选器，然后让AI代理丰富联系人、验证邮箱、研究每条线索，并将最终列表同步至CRM。凭借15家数据供应商的丰富数据瀑布流、AI研究列和一键CRM同步，Cleanlist帮助GTM团队无需拼凑六种工具即可构建列表。
products.description: Cleanlist AI turns any prospecting input into a verified, enriched, CRM-ready lead list. Upload a CSV, paste LinkedIn or Sales Navigator URLs, add domains, or use search filters, then let AI agents enrich contacts, verify emails, research each lead, and sync the final list to your CRM. With a 15-provider enrichment waterfall, AI research columns, and one-click CRM sync, Cleanlist helps GTM teams build lists without stitching together six tools.

products.name: mectrics
products.tagline: Your Mac's vitals in the menu bar. Free and open source.
products.summaryZh: 你的Mac状态一览，尽在菜单栏。免费且开源。
products.descriptionZh: 菜单栏中的CPU、内存、电池、网络、磁盘、GPU、温度和风扇。您选择显示哪些，点击即可查看背后的详情。Compact Health将整台机器整合为一个项目，平时保持安静，直到有异常情况出现。支持MIT许可，macOS 15及以上版本。
products.description: CPU, memory, battery, network, disk, GPU, temperature and fans in your menu bar. You pick which ones show, and a click opens the detail behind it. Compact Health folds the whole machine into one item that stays quiet until something's off. MIT, macOS 15+.

products.name: DepthData
products.tagline: The system of record for your company's AI spend.
products.summaryZh: 公司AI支出的记录系统。
products.descriptionZh: 如今企业为四五种AI工具（ChatGPT、Claude、Copilot等）付费，却连基本问题都答不上来：我们花了多少钱、谁在用、哪些席位闲置？DepthData将所有AI工具整合为一个可审计的支出与采用情况视图。其独特之处在于：每个数字都标注了验证方式，我们从不读取提示词，并明确展示每个供应商API能暴露和不能暴露的内容。它是企业AI支出的可信记录系统。
products.description: Companies now pay for four or five AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and more) but can't answer the basics: what are we spending, who's using it, and which seats sit idle? DepthData connects every AI tool into one audit ready view of spend and adoption. What makes it different: every number is labeled by how it's verified, we never read prompts, and we show exactly what each vendor's API can and can't expose. The trusted system of record for your company's AI spend.

products.name: Halo by Scam AI
products.tagline: Know who’s real on every video call
products.summaryZh: 在每一次视频通话中，识别真实身份。
products.descriptionZh: 你下一次视频通话中的那个人可能并非真人。有了Halo，你无需猜测。Halo实时保护你的Zoom、Teams或Google Meet通话，一旦检测到合成面孔便会立即标记，且全程在你的设备上运行。深度伪造视频通话已被用于诈骗全球个人和企业，只是大多数人无从辨别。从确认你招聘的对象到确认你汇款的对象，Halo都能在造成损失前将其识破。
products.description: The person on your next video call might not be real. With Halo you don't have to guess. Halo secures your Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet call live and flags synthetic faces the moment it detects one, entirely on your device. Deepfake video calls are already being used to scam people and businesses around the world, it's just that most people have no way to tell. From confirming who you're hiring to confirming who you're wiring money to, Halo catches it before it costs you.

products.name: witr
products.tagline: Why is this running? Trace process, port, container or file
products.summaryZh: 为什么它在运行？追踪进程、端口、容器或文件。
products.descriptionZh: ps、top和lsof告诉你什么在运行，而witr告诉你为什么。将其指向一个进程、PID、端口、容器或文件，它会追踪解释其来源的链条——systemd、supervisor、shell或cron——以及谁启动的、何时、从哪里，还有值得注意的警告。直接运行可进入交互式TUI，包含进程、端口、容器和锁标签页。或者脚本化使用：--short输出单行链条，--json配合真实退出码。一个静态Go二进制文件，支持Linux、macOS、Windows和BSD。
products.description: ps, top and lsof tell you what is running. witr tells you why. Point it at a process, PID, port, container or file and it traces the chain that explains it - systemd, supervisor, shell or cron - plus who started it, when, from where, and the warnings worth knowing. Run it bare for an interactive TUI with Processes, Ports, Containers and Locks tabs. Or script it: --short for a one-line chain, --json with real exit codes. One static Go binary for Linux, macOS, Windows and BSD.

products.name: Customer.io Summer Release
products.tagline: New ways to reach customers in the moments that matter
products.summaryZh: 在关键时刻触达客户的新方式
products.descriptionZh: Customer.io迄今最大规模的一次发布，带来了更强大的新方式，在扩展的触发条件、界面和渠道中，于关键时刻精准触达客户。通过地理围栏、实时通知、灵活的短信服务商、通知收件箱等功能触达客户。改进的WhatsApp管理、更智能的AI等，全部集成于一个平台。
products.description: Customer.io's most expansive launch yet brings powerful new ways to engage customers exactly when it matters across expanded triggers, surfaces, and channels. Reach customers with geofencing, Live Notifications, flexible SMS providers, notification inbox, and beyond. Improved WhatsApp management, smarter AI, and more, all from one platform.

products.name: Screencap
products.tagline: Turn your team's real workflows into AI training data
products.summaryZh: 将团队的真实工作流程转化为AI训练数据
products.descriptionZh: Screencap记录工作的真实过程：屏幕、点击、按键、窗口上下文，团队可利用它将实际工作流程转化为结构化的数据集，用于自动化和AI训练。录制过程中强制执行同意与隐私保护，最敏感的应用程序在写入任何内容前即被阻止，每条记录在离开设备前都会经过清理和审查。支持macOS，开源。可免费试用个人版，或联系我们了解团队试点。
products.description: Screencap records how work actually happens: screen, clicks, keystrokes, window context and teams can use it to turn real workflows into structured datasets for automation and AI training. Consent and privacy are enforced while recording so most sensitive apps are blocked before anything is written, and every trace is scrubbed and reviewed before it leaves a machine. macOS, open source. Try it solo with a free trial, or talk to us about a team pilot.

products.name: Gemini Robotics 2
products.tagline: Google's AI brain for the next generation of robots
products.summaryZh: 谷歌为下一代机器人打造的AI大脑
products.descriptionZh: Gemini Robotics 2是Google DeepMind迈向智能机器人的最新一步，这些机器人能够在物理世界中理解、推理并行动。依托先进的Gemini模型，它为不同形态和尺寸的机器人带来了全身智能、灵巧操作和自适应推理能力。从复杂的物理任务到多机器人协作，Gemini Robotics 2让我们更接近机器人能与人类并肩工作的未来。
products.description: Gemini Robotics 2 is Google DeepMind’s latest step toward intelligent robots that can understand, reason, and act in the physical world. Powered by advanced Gemini models, it brings whole-body intelligence, dexterous manipulation, and adaptive reasoning to robots of different shapes and sizes. From complex physical tasks to multi-robot collaboration, Gemini Robotics 2 moves us closer to a future where robots can work alongside humans.

products.name: TraceLLM
products.tagline: OpenTelemetry for production AI applications
products.summaryZh: 面向生产环境AI应用的OpenTelemetry
products.descriptionZh: Tracellm是面向生产环境AI应用的可观测性平台。监控LLM工作流中的提示执行、令牌消耗、延迟、跨度、错误及模型调用。通过OpenTelemetry（OTLP）导出追踪数据，在瓶颈影响用户前快速识别。
products.description: Tracellm is an observability platform for production AI applications. Monitor prompt execution, token consumption, latency, spans, errors, and model calls across your LLM workflows. Export traces using OpenTelemetry (OTLP) and quickly identify bottlenecks before they impact users

products.name: Mubert API
products.tagline: Edit tracks & stems, get consistent music with new engine
products.summaryZh: 编辑音轨与分轨，借助全新引擎获得一致的音乐
products.descriptionZh: 认识全新的Mubert API。编辑曲目、替换音轨，并利用我们最新的引擎生成更连贯的音乐。创建长达2小时的曲目，实时流式传输音乐，并通过Skills在几分钟内将Mubert集成到你的工作流程中。
products.description: Meet the new Mubert API. Edit tracks, swap stems, and generate more consistent music with our latest engine. Create tracks up to 2 hours long, stream music in real time, and integrate Mubert into your pipeline in minutes with Skills.

products.name: Polygres
products.tagline: Turn your entire database into a context window for AI
products.summaryZh: 将整个数据库转化为AI的上下文窗口
products.descriptionZh: Polygres将Postgres转化为AI代理的工作记忆。通过一个混合API，检索结构化行、关联关系、语义匹配和全文结果。无需单独的向量存储、图数据库或同步管道。在已有数据之上构建有依据的代理，关系、图和向量上下文在源头即已结合。可使用托管云服务，或通过我们的开源组件自行部署。Polygres目前免费使用，只需注册即可！
products.description: Polygres turns Postgres into working memory for AI agents. Retrieve structured rows, connected relationships, semantic matches, and full-text results through one hybrid API. All without a separate vector store, graph database, or sync pipeline. Build grounded agents over the data you already have, with relational, graph, and vector context joined at the source. Use the managed cloud or self-host with our open source components. Polygres is currently free to use, just sign up!

products.name: VulX Watch
products.tagline: Vibe-code freely. We watch your back
products.summaryZh: 自由地随性编码，我们为你保驾护航。
products.descriptionZh: 构建你应用的人工智能无法验证自身工作。VulX Watch可以，连接GitHub仓库，它会独立审查你的AI实际交付的内容，向你展示哪些部分存在漏洞，并为每项发现提供证据和确切代码行。只读模式，绝不触碰你的代码，免费试用。继续快速构建，让独立工具认证你所创造的东西。
products.description: The AI that built your app can't verify its own work. VulX Watch can, connect a GitHub repo and it independently reviews what your AI actually shipped, shows you what's vulnerable, and backs every finding with the evidence and the exact line. Read-only, never touches your code, free to try. Keep building fast, and let something independent certify what you made.

products.name: NexaLibre
products.tagline: Secure hosting for whatever your AI builds
products.summaryZh: 为您的AI构建内容提供安全托管
products.descriptionZh: 将AI生成的代码即刻转化为可投入生产的实时应用，或从数百个开源应用中选择部署，无需从零开始。NexaLibre提供安全、自动化的托管服务，内置HTTPS、可靠备份及无缝自定义域名支持。告别繁琐的服务器配置，今日即可上线。
products.description: Turn AI-generated code into live, production-ready applications instantly—or deploy from hundreds of open-source apps if you don't want to build from scratch. NexaLibre provides secure, automated hosting with built-in HTTPS, reliable backups, and seamless custom domain support. Stop wrestling with server setups and launch today.

products.name: Servey
products.tagline: Your Mac, in your pocket - control it from anywhere
products.summaryZh: 你的Mac，尽在掌中——随时随地掌控它
products.descriptionZh: Servey将你的Mac屏幕镜像到iPhone和iPad，支持完整的鼠标、键盘以及真实终端——在你的网络上硬件加速，其他任何地方则通过私有点对点连接。
products.description: Servey mirrors your Mac to your iPhone and iPad with full mouse, keyboard, and a real terminal - hardware-accelerated on your network, private peer-to-peer anywhere else.

products.name: Franchise Builders™
products.tagline: The only tool a franchisor needs
products.summaryZh: 特许经营商唯一需要的工具
products.descriptionZh: 特许经营创建者构建特许经营体系：生成您的FDD、特许经营协议与运营手册，在FMLS市场上架，并运营您的特许经营门户。
products.description: Franchise creator to build a franchise: generate your FDD, franchise agreement & operations manual, list on the FMLS marketplace, and run your franchise portal.

products.name: BackdropKit
products.tagline: Launch-ready screenshots and demo videos private by design
products.summaryZh: 默认私密的上线截图与演示视频
products.descriptionZh: BackdropKit可将原始产品截图或演示视频转化为完整的发布素材包，无需上传任何内容。添加或生成背景、高亮并标注界面元素、遮盖敏感文本，并导出适配各渠道尺寸的图片、视频、GIF、缩略图、帖子文案及替代文本。所有操作均在浏览器本地完成——免费、私密且无水印。
products.description: BackdropKit turns a raw product screenshot or demo video into a complete launch kit without sending it anywhere. Add or generate backgrounds, spotlight and call out UI, redact sensitive text, and export channel-sized images, video, GIF, thumbnail, post copy, and alt text. Everything runs locally in your browser—free, private, and watermark-free.

products.name: Poth Labs
products.tagline: The customer brain for your company
products.summaryZh: 贵公司的客户大脑
products.descriptionZh: 客户知识不是文档的堆砌，而是关系的网络。Poth在回答问题前会构建一个鲜活的客户模型，因此Ask Poth能够基于公司全部所知进行推理，而非仅总结孤立来源。这解锁了单一来源无法回答的问题，从驱动流失的因素到客户采用或放弃功能的原因。每项结论都有证据支撑。若答案缺失，Poth会启动自适应调查以收集所需信息。
products.description: Customer knowledge isn't a collection of documents. It's a network of relationships. Poth builds a living model of your customers before answering questions, so Ask Poth can reason across all your company knows instead of summarizing isolated sources. That unlocks questions no single source can answer, from what's driving churn to why customers adopt or abandon features. Every conclusion is grounded in evidence. If the answer isn't there, Poth launches adaptive surveys to collect what's missing.

products.name: Nommer.ai
products.tagline: Turn recipes into 2-player mode
products.summaryZh: 将食谱转换为双人模式
products.descriptionZh: Nommer将任何食谱变为双人模式，让你们轻松一起烹饪。应用的核心是一个独特的烹饪界面，将食谱拆分为每位厨师的步骤；例如，一人负责切洋葱备料，另一人制作酱汁。在最后一步，一切总能团队协作完成。与其他食谱应用不同，你可以导入并烹饪任意数量的食谱；只有与另一位厨师一起烹饪时才消耗积分。
products.description: Nommer turns any recipe into 2-player mode so you can cook together with ease. The core of the app is a unique cooking interface that splits a recipe into steps for each chef; one might do the onion cutting prep while the other creates a sauce for instance. At the final step, everything always comes together as a team. Unlike other recipe apps, you can import and cook as many recipes as you want; you only spend credits when you cook together with another chef.

products.name: Ctrl+Shift+3
products.tagline: A calm, chronological, text-first community platform.
products.summaryZh: 一个平静、按时间顺序、以文字为主的社区平台。
products.descriptionZh: 一个平静、按时间顺序、以文字为主的社区平台。
products.description: A calm, chronological, text-first community platform.
